thread:
Alex: Quick weekly pulse — heads-up: v3.7 release train, doing a targeted traffic rebalance for inference + embeddings routes this morning.
Maya: Canary started @ 09:00 UTC. Early metric: small p95 latency bump on embeddings-infer (~+45ms) detected at ~09:12.
Sahil: Investigating. Seeing kernel-side queuing on canary GPU hosts 4-7. Rolling back the quant-plugin on canary nodes now.
Sahil: Running:
```
kubectl -n canary rollout undo deployment/quant-plugin --to-revision=12
```
deploy-bot: [09:18 UTC] Canary deploy v3.7.2 -> rollout-status: 3/3 pods ready. No crashloops. (ci: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/789)
Maya: After rollback the p95 trended back to baseline within ~3m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/ingress/embeddings — watch the red clusters.
Lisa: Because this affected latency briefly, instituting a temporary release freeze for the train: 10:00–12:00 UTC. Hold non-critical deploys and routing-changing flags. Ping me for exemptions with test plan.
Alex: Ops plan: monitor 1h post-fix, then resume gradual rollout with reduced concurrency. Priority is to avoid client-side retry storms.
Maya: Short changelog items added: - quant-plugin rollback on canary; - traffic rebalance for embeddings-infer; - temporary release freeze 10-12 UTC. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/release-notes/456
Sahil: Running 60m heat test now, will post final readout. If anything flares, we'll abort resume and extend freeze.
Alex: Thanks — keep status updates here. :thumbsup:
